independent_axes: physical age t and throughput A
reference: Exact current-state posterior or declared query distribution under the admitted physical/aging model, with every observation/prior owned once

local_components.m_k: difference between implemented and admitted physical/aging update

state_error.strong_metric_case: L_k<=1 for common Markov kernel and shared positive likelihood in log-density oscillation metric; local defects may be infinite if support or deterministic maps disagree
state_error.strict_contraction_case: Only if independently established: L_blocks<=rho<1 and defect<=delta gives e_n<=rho^n*e_0+delta*(1-rho^n)/(1-rho)
state_error.interpretation: No arbitrary decay multiplier, compaction reset or invented process noise is permitted to make the bound small

query_error.expectation: |E_q g-E_pi g| <= range(g)*tanh(D(q,pi)/4) when finite D exists
query_error.alternative: A tighter physical-query metric is allowed only with proved propagation closure/stability
query_error.distinct_from: Actual-cell point error, irreducible posterior uncertainty, noise/model calibration and coverage

failure_models.name: repeated_reprojection
failure_models.formula: D_m=m*epsilon in the two-state log-odds counterexample
failure_models.control: Idempotence for no-new-evidence operations, exact sufficient updates or charged lifetime defect

failure_models.name: fixed_model_bias_growing_confidence
failure_models.formula: point bias approaches b while standardized bias grows proportional to sqrt(n)
failure_models.control: Calibrated representation/model discrepancy retained in uncertainty; do not infer accuracy from narrow posterior

failure_models.name: static_pooling_of_aging
failure_models.formula: For theta(t)=theta0+v*t, equal-time stationary pooling yields theta0+v*t/2, lagging current theta by-v*t/2

failure_models.name: forecast_horizon_sensitivity
failure_models.formula: r(H,tau)=(1-exp(-H/tau))/a(t_star,tau), bounded by1/a_min; query depends on mixed rF moments
failure_models.control: Preserve weighted response/cross moments over the declared horizon family; do not confuse this with lifetime accumulation

gallery_error.exact_case: Finite shared log-likelihood span gives zero representation defect for real-arithmetic coefficient addition
gallery_error.approximate_case: If each event contributes residual r_i(theta), cumulative log-error oscillation <=sum_i osc(r_i), even when the same template is reused
gallery_error.merge_obligation: Bound the aggregate remainder over the reachable joint health/state domain, including cross terms and provenance

required_measurements_before_numeric_ten: Per-operation approximation bounds under an exact replay or certified local operator, not finite particle-reference differences alone
Aging transition uncertainty/rate constraints and state-continuity convention for R,C,Q
Query error allocation and admissible excitation/availability conditions
Maximum delivered records/token updates and finite arithmetic ranges
A valid closure or contraction proof in the selected error metric
